text:
Amy L.: Hi team — urgent. My partner had a bike accident while I'm traveling and needs proof of insurance at the ER in Barcelona. I can't pull up our digital ID in the benefits app because the SSO MFA prompt isn't showing. Can someone generate a temporary insurance card I can share? 🙏
Carol - People Ops: I'm sorry to hear that, Amy. We can help. Have you tried the benefits web portal (incognito) instead of the app? Sometimes the SSO cookie causes MFA to fail.
Amy L.: yes tried incognito and clearing cache, still stuck. The app just loops on 'verifying' after I enter email.
IT Support Bot: @Amy L. — if SSO MFA isn't completing, try the backup one-time passcode flow from the SSO login page (link sent to your work email). If that doesn't arrive, reply here and we can escalate to Okta.
Benefits Bot: Temporary digital ID generation is available via the secure benefits admin. To request us to generate an e-card, please submit the secure form: https://benefits.redwood-internal/secure-id-request (requires last 4 of dependent SSN and DOB).
Alex M.: Amy, if you're comfortable, DM me the last 4 and DOB and I'll submit the secure form for you. We'll not post any PII here.
Amy L.: DMing now. Thanks Alex.
Carol - People Ops: For visibility — once we generate the temp e-card, you'll get a PDF with the insurer member ID and group number you can show to the hospital. It also contains an issuer phone number for the provider to call to verify coverage. Typical turnaround ~15–30 minutes.
Alex M.: Submitted request to benefits admin. They confirmed receipt.
Benefits Bot: Request received. Generated temporary e-card (expires in 72 hours). Download link sent via secure DM to requester.
Amy L.: Got it, received PDF + instructions on adding to Apple Wallet too. Hospital accepted it, they took a copy. Thank you everyone ❤️
Carol - People Ops: Glad this worked. Follow-up: we'll also open a claim assistance ticket with insurer if you want us to coordinate billing/waiver for copay. Say the word and we'll handle it.
Amy L.: Please open the claim assistance ticket — would appreciate help with the copay/claim.
Alex M.: Noted, moving to claims queue and tagging @provider-advocacy. We'll update here when the insurer responds. :thumbsup:
Carol - People Ops: Quick note for others — do not post SSNs or DOBs in channel. Use the secure form or DM People Ops. Updated short procedure pinned to #people-ops SOPs.
